title: HCF of 252 and 198 from prime factors
caption: The overlap holds the primes 252 and 198 share: 2 × 3 × 3 = 18, the HCF. Multiplying everything in the diagram gives the LCM, 2,772.
alt: A Venn diagram: circle 252 holds 2, 7; circle 198 holds 11; the overlap holds 2, 3, 3.
description: The primes both share, 2, 3, 3, go in the overlap.
The rest of 252's primes (2, 7) and of 198's (11) go in their own parts.
The overlap multiplies to the HCF, 18.
